parts.one_line: Design the work under a chosen plan item before it is built: how it is built, and what a person meets on its surface, against the project's standards.

For the tree gathered under the item the technical lead names, designs each story, chore and spike in one design with a technical part, its components, classes, functions, data model, interfaces, libraries and patterns, drawn as diagrams a CTO can read, and a surface part, what a person sees and does there and how each screen will look, against the project's standards with the deployment design among them, and with no test in it.
When the work, a project standard or what the build finds no longer matches the design, the technical lead confirms an update, and what held before stays readable with why it changed.
